articles.title: Is Kyle Tucker a $240M mistake? Dave Roberts addresses Dodgers star's alarming slump
articles.standfirst: Kyle Tucker was supposed to be the missing piece for the Dodgers. Instead, his struggles have raised major concerns in Los Angeles.
articles.summary: Kyle Tucker was supposed to be the missing piece for the Dodgers. Instead, his struggles have raised major concerns in Los Angeles.
articles.body:
The massive investment the Los Angeles Dodgers made in Kyle Tucker has not been fully reflected in his performance, as he has fallen far short of expectations.

Tucker, who signed a contract that made him the player with the highest true average annual value in MLB history , has not lived up to the enormous expectations surrounding his arrival in Los Angeles. His 0.1 WAR is the worst mark of his career since his rookie season, while his defensive struggles have become a growing concern as his bat continues to remain cold.

Dave Roberts backs Kyle Tucker amid Dodgers struggles

During an appearance on MLB Network Radio , manager Dave Roberts defended his right fielder and made it clear that he believes Tucker can overcome this difficult stretch.

“I think that it's one of those things I think for me is my message to him is you're not alone. But when you can you catch a ball at your shoe tops and drop it, that's where you're kind of that's a tell where you're not in a good spot mentally. You know, people miss fly balls all the time. It happens. Shouldn't happen, but it does,” Roberts said.

The Dodgers manager explained that he has also noticed some lack of confidence in Tucker’s at-bats.

“But when you're catching it that low, it's just kind of you're really unsure, right. The at-bats of kind of the indecisiveness, and I think for me is just wanting him to just kind of go out there and expect good things to happen. Go play free and easy.

“You're not gonna, you know, have a 900 this year, but you know each day just go out there and help us win the game. And I think that when you start just playing just to win and take the individual performance out of it hopefully that kind of alleviates some kind of angst and some frustrations. But yeah, I mean he's probably never struggled like this in his life.”

The Dodgers expected Tucker to be the definitive solution to their search for a consistent right fielder. After rotating players such as Jason Heyward , Kevin Kiermaier , and Michael Conforto at the position, the organization made a major investment in the former Chicago Cubs outfielder to fill that void.

However, so far, Tucker has the lowest WAR among Los Angeles’ regular starters, while his backup Alex Call has performed at a better level in fewer opportunities.

Despite the difficult adjustment, Roberts and the Dodgers continue to support the 2 9-year-old player , believing he can return to the level that made him one of MLB’s biggest stars .

articles.title: Is Mark Walter forced to sell the Dodgers? Bill Simmons makes shocking prediction
articles.standfirst: After selling the Lakers, Mark Walter’s Dodgers future is now under the spotlight.
articles.summary: After selling the Lakers, Mark Walter’s Dodgers future is now under the spotlight.
articles.body:
Journalist and analyst Bill Simmons believes the Los Angeles Dodgers could be the next major asset owned by billionaire Mark Walter to hit the market, following the record-breaking $12.5 billion sale of the Los Angeles Lakers and amid growing scrutiny surrounding his business empire.

During the latest episode of The Bill Simmons Podcast , Simmons discussed Walter’s situation, pointing to the Lakers sale and reports that the businessman is negotiating the sale of his stake in Chelsea FC . The commentator also speculated on the potential outcome of the federal investigation involving Walter and his businesses.

“It’s starting to seem like he might actually go to jail. He’s already shed himself of the Lakers. He’s selling his Chelsea stake reportedly right now, which was like 12.5%, and my guess is that the Dodgers are going to be next,” Simmons said. “So, what is this? Are we moving toward a Bernie Madoff, Ivan Boesky-type situation? Will the words ‘Mark Walter today pled guilty’ be said in the next two years?”

Walter has not been charged with any crime , meaning Simmons’ comments are purely speculation about where the ongoing federal investigation could ultimately lead.

Federal prosecutors and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) have been investigating potential financial irregularities involving Walter’s business interests. As part of the investigation, federal agents reportedly previously seized the businessman’s phones and computers, while two insurance companies under his control received grand jury subpoenas in February.

Simmons believes Walter’s entire sports empire could be at risk

Sam Koppelman , who joined Simmons during the discussion, agreed that Walter’s sports holdings could potentially be on the table.

“I think it’s really possible,” Koppelman said. “I also think the Trump administration has not put away very many billionaires and so I’m sure they work something out. But I don’t think there’s a single safe asset in the entire Mark Walter cinematic universe. Like, I think it’s potentially all for sale and I do think that the Dodgers being sold — I think all of this is on the table.”

A Dodgers sale would have massive MLB implications

Walter’s potential departure from the Dodgers would have a major impact across Major League Baseball. The businessman has been the team’s controlling owner and chairman since Guggenheim Baseball Management acquired the franchise in 2012 .

“That’s why it’s such a bigger story than just the Lakers,” Simmons said. “If he has to sell the Dodgers, who spent so much money over the last seven years that they’re going to single-handedly create the baseball lockout next year. They also won two titles. He’s had all this extra money to buy the last two World Series titles. The Dodgers are back-to-back champions partly because of all the f***ing money this guy spent.”

Under Walter’s ownership, Los Angeles has become one of baseball’s most dominant organizations, combining aggressive spending with consistent regular-season success. The Dodgers have won three World Series championships during his tenure, including back-to-back titles in 2024 and 2025 .

For now, there is no confirmed agreement for Walter to sell the Dodgers . However, Simmons’ comments have once again raised questions about the future of the businessman’s sports portfolio as the federal investigation continues.

On the field, the Dodgers remain focused on pursuing a third consecutive championship. Los Angeles leads the National League West with a 76-51 record, ahead of the San Diego Padres (68-59), as the postseason approaches.

articles.title: Roki Sasaki has been on fire since major change - and it has nothing to do with Tarik Skubal or Shohei Ohtani
articles.standfirst: The Los Angeles Dodgers starting pitcher has turned around his 2026 season at the perfect time.
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers starting pitcher has turned around his 2026 season at the perfect time.
articles.body:
Heading into the MLB Trade Deadline , there was only one question mark surrounding the Los Angeles Dodgers : Was their starting pitching rotation going to hold up until and through the postseason?

The front office clearly had those doubts, as they pulled off a big trade for Tarik Skubal . With Shohei Ohtani an unknown - on the mound - going forward, no one was quite sure what the rotation was going to look like. Blake Snell has now returned from injury, and Tyler Glasnow is getting closer to a return of his own. Yet it might be Roki Sasaki who's been the biggest benefactor of all of this chaos.

Since the All-Star break, Sasaki has been on a tear. Over his last six starts, he's given up just nine earned runs over 34.3 innings, while punching out nearly one batter per inning . In fact, two of those earned runs should probably have been unearned due to a poor route taken by Teoscar Hernandez in Sasaki's most recent start.

Roki Sasaki seems to have stopped tipping pitches since switching to larger glove

Regardless, Sasaki has figured things out at the perfect time for the Dodgers. As it turns out, Sasaki's big change to turn around his season had nothing to do with the other pitchers coming and going from the rotation: Instead, it's been using a large glove in order to keep him from tipping pitches .

The Dodgers' pitching coaches implored Sasaki to make the switch to a different glove, and the results speak for themselves. Now, the Dodgers are almost fully ready for the postseason; they just need Ohtani to get back on the mound, too .

articles.title: Mookie Betts and Miguel Rojas deliver honest verdict on Kyle Tucker's Dodgers slump
articles.standfirst: Kyle Tucker’s $240 million contract is under the spotlight. Are the Dodgers’ concerns growing?
articles.summary: Kyle Tucker’s $240 million contract is under the spotlight. Are the Dodgers’ concerns growing?
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Dodgers continue to pile up wins, but Kyle Tucker ’s prolonged offensive struggles have become one of the biggest storylines surrounding the team. The four-time All-Star arrived in Los Angeles with a four-year, $240 million contract before the start of the 2026 season , and his struggles at the plate have already drawn comments from key clubhouse figures such as Mookie Betts and Miguel Rojas .

The pressure of a massive contract is weighing on Tucker

Tucker is hitting .232/.327/.368 with just 11 home runs in roughly 120 games , numbers far below the level he displayed during his stints with the Houston Astros and Chicago Cubs . The outfielder has also struggled both at Dodger Stadium and on the road, leading to some boos from frustrated fans.

The slump has turned the 2022 World Series champion with Houston into one of the most scrutinized players in the Dodgers’ lineup. However, he recently snapped the worst hitless streak of his career, going 26 consecutive at-bats without a hit, with an RBI double during Los Angeles’ three-game sweep of the Colorado Rockies .

Mookie Betts, host of Bleacher Report’s On Bas e with Mookie Betts , discussed Tucker’s situation alongside Miguel Rojas and highlighted the pressure that comes with a contract of that magnitude.

“You give somebody that type of contract, there's going to be external pressure and really internal pressure for himself, because he knows he needs to play well,” Betts said.

Rojas, the Dodgers’ hero from the 2025 World Series , also defended his teammate and emphasized the support that exists inside the clubhouse.

“When you feel good, you play good. When you go out there every day knowing the guys have your back, it’s a good feeling… you look to your left and your right and see guys who are going to support you, even if things are not going great,” Rojas added.

Dodgers remain confident in their star

Despite his struggles, the Dodgers continue to believe in Tucker’s talent heading into the final stretch of the 2026 season . The messages from Betts and Rojas reflect a team standing behind one of its most important players while hoping he can rediscover his best form before the playoffs.

articles.title: Where to watch Dodgers - Pirates? TV channel, streaming and game schedule at Dodger Stadium
articles.standfirst: The Pittsburgh Pirates arrive at Dodger Stadium to face the Los Angeles team
articles.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates arrive at Dodger Stadium to face the Los Angeles team
articles.body:
Premium pitching against a batting lineup that can't find its direction. The Los Angeles Dodgers host the Pittsburgh Pirates in an interleague matchup that underscores the gap separating the two franchises in this stretch of the 2026 Major League Baseball season.

The Dodgers come in red-hot: a record of 77 wins and 51 losses, leaders of the National League West and second overall in MLB, behind only Milwaukee. Their offense has produced 640 runs with a +145 run differential, the credentials of a team heading into October with authority.

On the other side, the Pirates are climbing uphill. With 63 wins and 66 losses, they sit in fourth place in the National League Central and 16th in the overall standings . Curiously, their offense is not the problem—they have produced 646 runs, even one more than the Dodgers—but pitching that has allowed 615 keeps them at just a +31 run differential.

The question for Pittsburgh is maintaining the pace away from home against one of the deepest rosters in baseball .

Schedule, venue, and where to watch the following Dodgers - Pirates games

The first pitch of Los Angeles vs. Pittsburgh is scheduled for this Friday, August 21, 2026 at 10:10 p.m. Eastern Time (9:10 Central Time and 7:10 Pacific Time) , at the legendary Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, California, a colossus with a capacity of 56,000 fans.

The other two games will be:

Date : Saturday, August 22, 2026

Date : Sunday, August 23, 2026

Central Time : 12:35 p.m.

Pacific Time : 10:35 a.m.

The broadcasts of the following Dodgers games will be available on MLB.TV via streaming , and locally in Los Angeles and Pittsburgh on Spectrum SportsNet LA and SportsNet Pittsburgh.

What will the lineups be for Dodgers - Pirates?

The Dodgers boast a luxury rotation led by Yoshinobu Yamamoto , Blake Snell, Tyler Glasnow, and young Japanese pitcher Roki Sasaki, backed by a bullpen featuring big names like Tanner Scott, Blake Treinen, Evan Phillips, and Edwin Díaz. It is a pitching staff built to dominate high-stakes matchups.

Pittsburgh, for its part, has Paul Skenes as its winning card: when the ace takes the mound, any lineup looks vulnerable . Alongside him are Mitch Keller, Jared Jones, and Bubba Chandler. At the plate, the offensive reference is veteran Dominican Marcell Ozuna as the designated hitter, accompanied by catcher Henry Davis.

articles.title: Dodgers unveil epic Luka Doncic bobblehead giveaway to bridge L.A. sports fandoms
articles.standfirst: Dodgers and Lakers fandoms collide in a must-have Luka Doncic collectible
articles.summary: Dodgers and Lakers fandoms collide in a must-have Luka Doncic collectible
articles.body:
Los Angeles sports fans are getting a unique opportunity to celebrate two of the city’s biggest teams at the same time. The Los Angeles Dodgers will honor Lakers superstar Luka Doncic with a special bobblehead giveaway when they host the Pittsburgh Pirates on Friday, August 21.

The promotion is officially part of the Dodgers’ 2026 giveaway calendar, making Doncic one of several major sports and entertainment figures featured during the club’s home schedule.

The bobblehead will be available to fans attending Friday night’s 7:10 p.m. PDT game, with giveaways distributed while supplies last. The Dodgers have listed the promotion as a stadium-wide giveaway.

It’s an especially fitting crossover in a city where Dodgers and Lakers fandom often overlap. Although the teams play different sports, their supporters share a strong connection built around championship expectations and Los Angeles’ distinctive sports culture.

Doncic has also become one of the most recognizable athletes in the city. After taking over as the Lakers’ franchise centerpiece, the Slovenian guard delivered another spectacular regular season in 2025-26.

He averaged 33.5 points, 7.7 rebounds and 8.3 assists per game, establishing himself as one of the NBA’s most productive offensive players.

A crossover giveaway that makes perfect sense for Los Angeles

The timing of the promotion only makes the connection stronger. With Doncic now firmly established as the Lakers’ leading star, a bobblehead featuring him inside Dodger Stadium effectively brings two enormous Los Angeles fan bases together.

It’s a chance for Lakers fans to add an unusual Doncic collectible to their collection. For Dodgers fans who also follow basketball, it’s a memorable piece that represents the overlap between the city’s baseball and basketball communities.

The Dodgers’ promotional schedule has already featured several popular bobbleheads this season, including tributes to Max Muncy, Clayton Kershaw and Reggie Smith. Doncic’s appearance stands out, however, because he isn’t a Dodgers player.

The promotion also comes one day before another major Dodgers giveaway: a Shohei Ohtani “Starter Series” bobblehead against Pittsburgh on Saturday. That back-to-back schedule puts two of Los Angeles’ biggest modern sports stars at the center of consecutive promotional nights.

The Doncic bobblehead is a snapshot of how intertwined Los Angeles’ sports communities have become. Dodgers fans can celebrate their baseball team while taking home a reminder of the Lakers’ new era, and with Doncic carrying enormous expectations into the future, this collectible could become an even more interesting keepsake over time.

articles.title: Dodgers - Braves Standings: Latest scores, highlights and H2H between both teams
articles.standfirst: Los Angeles enters the upcoming Atlanta series with the better record, but the Braves have already shown they can trouble the reigning champions
articles.summary: Los Angeles enters the upcoming Atlanta series with the better record, but the Braves have already shown they can trouble the reigning champions
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Dodgers and Atlanta Braves are heading into one of the most intriguing series on the August schedule with both teams firmly in the National League playoff picture.

As of August 24, the Dodgers sit at 80-51, while the Braves are 76-55. Los Angeles has also been in excellent form recently, winning five consecutive games after completing a sweep of the Colorado Rockies and then taking a series from the Pittsburgh Pirates .

Atlanta , meanwhile, ended a five-game losing streak by defeating the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2 in the Little League Classic on Sunday.

The Dodgers ' latest victory came Monday, when Blake Snell delivered a strong performance in a 4-0 win over Pittsburgh. The result kept Los Angeles comfortably in control of the NL West and added to a recent surge at an important point of the season.

Atlanta arrives at Truist Park having stopped the bleeding against Milwaukee. Tyler Mahle worked more than five innings while allowing only one run, and Michael Harris II provided a crucial insurance run with his 21st home run of the season. Raisel Iglesias then recorded his 27th save.

The result was especially important for a Braves team that had struggled during its preceding road trip.

Dodgers vs. Braves: Head-to-head record and upcoming series

The two teams have already met three times in 2026, and Atlanta currently owns the edge.

The Braves won two of the three games when the teams met in Los Angeles from May 8-10. The Dodgers won the series opener 3-1, but Atlanta responded by taking the final two games by identical 7-2 scores. That leaves the Braves with a 2-1 advantage in the 2026 season series heading into the upcoming matchup.

That history adds another layer of intrigue to the three-game series in Atlanta.

The teams are scheduled to meet at Truist Park from August 25-27, with Tuesday's opener followed by games Wednesday and Thursday.

The series gives the Braves an opportunity to close some of the four-game gap separating them from Los Angeles, while the Dodgers can strengthen their position as one of the National League's leading teams.

The opening game is particularly noteworthy because Los Angeles is expected to bring Tyler Glasnow back into its rotation. Glasnow has been sidelined for more than three months with lower-back spasms and is scheduled to pitch against Atlanta on Tuesday.

He had posted a 2.72 ERA and 49 strikeouts across 39⅔ innings in seven starts before the injury.

The Dodgers ' pitching depth has become increasingly important as the club approaches the final weeks of the regular season. Los Angeles also recently added Tarik Skubal , who struck out 11 over seven innings in his first victory for the team.

Atlanta has plenty of reasons for confidence, too. Despite its recent slump, the Braves remain atop the NL East at 76-55, three games ahead of the Philadelphia Phillies .

Their +110 run differential also demonstrates that the team's overall performance has been considerably stronger than its recent 3-7 stretch might suggest.

Los Angeles, meanwhile, has established itself as the class of the NL West. ESPN's latest power rankings placed the Dodgers among the National League's top teams, while Atlanta also moved into the top three following its strong season-long performance.

articles.standfirst: A recent move by the franchise’s owner has reignited speculation about the Japanese star’s future.
articles.summary: A recent move by the franchise’s owner has reignited speculation about the Japanese star’s future.
articles.body:
Shohei Ohtani is enjoying another strong stretch with the Los Angeles Dodgers , but a recent move and growing speculation have raised questions about the possibility of his eventual departure from the team.

What sparked the speculation?

It all began with Mark Walter, the Dodgers’ owner, who recently sold his majority stake in the Los Angeles Lakers . The move raised questions about his other sports ventures and put the spotlight on a little-known condition in the Japanese star’s contract.

It involves the so-called “Key Man” clause, a provision that could allow Ohtani to reconsider his future with the Dodgers.

What does Shohei Ohtani’s clause say?

Ohtani’s contract includes a condition that allows him to leave the Dodgers if Mark Walter or Andrew Friedman are no longer in charge of the franchise , as both have been key figures in bringing him to Los Angeles and have continued to support his development with the team.

However, there is an important restriction: if Ohtani chooses to exercise the clause, his departure would not be immediate , as it could only take effect at the end of the season in which the change occurs.

Ohtani prepares to return to the mound

While questions surrounding his future are emerging off the field, Ohtani’s story continues to move forward on it.

Shohei Ohtani is expected to pitch during the Dodgers’ next homestand, scheduled for September 1 through 9, 2026 , although the exact date of his appearance has not yet been determined.

The Japanese star made his most recent pitching appearance on July 3 before left knee discomfort forced him to temporarily halt his work from the mound . At that point, he had recorded 8 wins, 2 losses and a 1.79 ERA, maintaining an impressive level of performance.

Now, all eyes are on his return to the mound and on seeing him resume a role he had been forced to put on hold for several weeks.

articles.standfirst: Shohei Ohtani is one step closer to returning to the mound — and the Dodgers just got a major boost.
articles.summary: Shohei Ohtani is one step closer to returning to the mound — and the Dodgers just got a major boost.
articles.body:
S hohei Ohtani , the Los Angeles Dodgers superstar, appears to be getting closer to returning to the mound in Major League Baseball .

The Japanese two-way star is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Friday as part of his preparation for a potential start Sunday against the Detroit Tigers, according to Jack Harris of California Post .

“Shohei Ohtani update: Dave Roberts said he will actually throw his bullpen on Friday, in anticipation of a possible start Sunday (Ohtani usually throws his bullpens two days before starts),” Harris shared in a post on X, formerly Twitter. “They’ll see how his ‘pen goes, but he’s definitely trending toward starting Sunday.”

It has been nearly two months since Ohtani’s last appearance as a pitcher for the Dodgers. His most recent outing on the mound came on July 4 against the San Diego Padres at Dodger Stadium , where he pitched six innings, allowing three earned runs on seven hits while striking out nine batters in Los Angeles’ 4-3 victory .

Since that outing, Ohtani has not been cleared to return to pitching due to knee and biceps issues.

If the Japanese superstar is not ready to start Sunday against the Tigers at Comerica Park , recently recovered Tyler Glasnow would take over as the starter, according to Harris. Otherwise, Glasnow would work in relief behind Ohtani, who would have his workload limited to just one inning.

So far this season, Ohtani owns an 8-2 record with an impressive 1.79 ERA across 14 starts . His return to the mound would provide a major boost for the Dodgers as they look to enter the final stretch of the season playing their best baseball.

articles.title: Dave Roberts forced into panic mode as another injury rocks the Dodgers
articles.standfirst: Roki Sasaki’s latest injury setback has forced the Dodgers to make a tough rotation decision.
articles.summary: Roki Sasaki’s latest injury setback has forced the Dodgers to make a tough rotation decision.
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Dodgers suffered a major blow in the final stretch of the season after confirming that Roki Sasaki will miss at least one turn in the rotation due to injury.

Dave Roberts announced that the Japanese pitcher will be placed on the injured list after suffering a blister on the middle finger of his right hand during his start Wednesday against the Atlanta Braves . The Dodgers manager also revealed that veteran left-hander Eric Lauer will take Sasaki’s spot in the rotation.

The injury occurred in the fourth inning of the game at Truist Park , when the training staff visited Sasaki on the mound before he was removed from the contest. The right-hander exited with the Dodgers leading 3-2 and runners on second and third base. His outing ended after 3.1 innings , allowing six hits, four earned runs, two walks, and striking out three batters, while also surrendering a solo home run to Matt Olson .

While a blister is rarely considered a serious injury, it can significantly impact a pitcher who relies on grip and feel to execute his pitches. That is why the Dodgers decided not to take any chances and give Sasaki time to fully recover, avoiding the risk of the issue worsening at such a crucial point of the season.

The timing could not be worse for Los Angeles. Sasaki had been one of the team’s biggest positive stories during the second half of the season, finally finding consistency after the All-Star break and establishing himself as a reliable piece of the rotation. His resurgence was even more valuable after a difficult rookie season in 2025 , when a shoulder injury sidelined him for several months.

Although the Dodgers expect his absence to be short, the injury puts even more pressure on a rotation that has constantly had to be reshuffled due to injuries among its starters.

That is where Eric Lauer comes in. The left-hander has split time between the rotation and bullpen throughout the season, becoming a versatile option for Roberts. He will now return to a starting role while Sasaki completes his recovery.

For now, the Dodgers remain optimistic about the situation. Placing Sasaki on the injured list is viewed primarily as a precautionary move rather than a sign of a major concern , and the team expects the Japanese star to return to the rotation once the blister has fully healed.

articles.summary: Los Angeles team arrives in Detroit aiming for another victory
articles.body:
The matchup between the Detroit Tigers and the Los Angeles Dodgers at Comerica Park pits two teams experiencing the 2016 MLB season at completely different extremes. The Dodgers arrive in Detroit firmly established among baseball's elite : they occupy second place in the National League and second place overall in the Major Leagues, with a record of 80 wins and 52 losses, only behind the Milwaukee Brewers. They are also the undisputed leaders of the National League West Division, with 656 runs scored and a +150 differential.

On the other side, the Tigers are going through a tough stretch. Detroit is in 23rd place overall and fourth in the American League Central Division , with a 62-71 record. What's striking is their run differential: +70, a number more typical of a contender than a losing team. That contrast—good pitching, but not the results—is the main story of this matchup.

What time does the Dodgers vs Tigers game start?

The first game of the series between L os Angeles and Detroit is scheduled to begin this Friday, August 28, 2026, at 6:40 p.m. ET (5:40 p.m. CT and 3:40 p.m. PT) . The game will be played at Comerica Park in Detroit, which has a capacity of 41,083 fans.

The following games in the series in Detroit will have the following schedules:

Date : Saturday, August 29th

Date : Sunday, August 30th

Where can you watch the entire Dodgers vs Tigers series?

For viewers outside of Detroit and Los Angeles, the broadcast will be available on MLB.tv , as it is for everyone outside the United States. Other ways to watch the upcoming games are:

TV Channel : Detroit SportsNet and SportsNet LA

Streaming : FUBO and MLB.tv

How are the Dodgers and Tigers approaching the series in Detroit?

The Los Angeles Dodgers are coming into this game in great form. In their last few games, they put together a solid run : a three-game sweep of the Colorado Rockies on the road and another complete sweep of the Pittsburgh Pirates at home, before falling 3-4 to the Atlanta Braves. Their offense is capable of scoring in large numbers and also of winning close games.

Detroit, on the other hand, has been inconsistent and on a downward trend. In their most recent series against the Tampa Bay Rays, they split the results : they lost 1-4, responded with a 4-1 victory, and then were shut out 0-3. Before that, they had suffered a very tough series in Kansas City. The Tigers alternate between tremendous offensive bursts—like the 14-0 sweep of Baltimore, the 13-1 sweep of the Athletics, or the 11-0 sweep of Seattle—and worrying scoring droughts. Inconsistency is their enemy.

What are the possible starting lineups for the Dodgers and Tigers in the upcoming games?

This is where the game gets fascinating. Detroit boasts one of the most feared rotations in baseball , led by ace Tarik Skubal. Alongside him is a stellar starting rotation that includes Framber Valdez, the 43-year-old veteran Justin Verlander, Jack Flaherty, Casey Mize, and prospect Jackson Jobe. The bullpen adds closing experience with names like Kenley Jansen and Kyle Finnegan.

The Dodgers are not to be outdone and perhaps boast the most stellar rotation in the MLB : Japanese pitchers Yoshinobu Yamamoto and Roki Sasaki, plus Blake Snell, Tyler Glasnow, and Gavin Stone. Their bullpen is equally deep, with Edwin Díaz, Tanner Scott, Blake Treinen, and Evan Phillips providing the necessary depth to secure the late innings.

With this level of arms on both sides, a low-scoring game wouldn't be surprising if the starters dominate ; but both lineups have enough firepower to turn a pitching stumble into a high-scoring afternoon.

articles.title: Tarik Skubal returns to Detroit with the intention of “tearing the Tigers to shreds
articles.standfirst: The former Tigers ace returns to Comerica Park in a Dodgers uniform just weeks after his departure
articles.summary: The former Tigers ace returns to Comerica Park in a Dodgers uniform just weeks after his departure
articles.body:
Tarik Skubal’s return to Detroit couldn’t come at a stranger time. Just weeks after the Detroit Tigers traded their former ace to the Los Angeles Dodgers , the two-time American League Cy Young winner is heading back to Comerica Park wearing the uniform of the opposition.

Friday night will mark Skubal’s first appearance against his former team since the trade. For the 29-year-old left-hander, it’s bound to be an emotional occasion.

Detroit drafted Skubal in the ninth round in 2018 out of Seattle University, and over eight seasons, the organization helped transform him from a promising prospect into one of baseball’s elite pitchers.

Tigers manager A.J. Hinch has admitted that the reunion isn’t something he’s particularly looking forward to.

“I wish it was next year," Hinch told USA TODAY Sports. “I don’t really want to go through the emotions again. It kind of puts a pit in your stomach. It was just so public."

Detroit had hoped to keep its ace through the end of the season and make another postseason push.

Those plans changed rapidly after the Tigers suffered a devastating loss to the Baltimore Orioles, blowing a seven-run lead before eventually falling 10-9 in 12 innings. Three days later, Skubal was gone.

The Tigers received three prospects from Los Angeles, while Skubal joined a Dodgers team with legitimate World Series ambitions.

Skubal knows emotions can’t get in the way

Despite the circumstances, Skubal understands that Friday’s game is still a baseball game. He’s expected to feel the weight of the moment when he steps onto the Comerica mound, but he knows he’ll have to put those feelings aside once the competition begins.

“I’m sure it will be emotional there just because of the history …” Skubal told reporters. “The whole process was emotional. I’m telling you, man, I’m really close with all those guys. That environment over there, everyone was together always."

That focus has also helped him adjust to life with the Dodgers. Through his first four starts in Los Angeles, Skubal has posted a 3.38 ERA with 30 strikeouts over 24 innings.

While his early numbers haven’t matched the dominant form he displayed in Detroit, there’s little doubt the Dodgers expect him to become a major weapon when October arrives.

Skubal has another unusual way of keeping himself grounded. During the season, he regularly watches true-crime documentaries as part of his daily routine. He recently watched a documentary about Charles Manson , joking that the experience was particularly wild.

As for Detroit fans, the focus will be less on Skubal’s routines and more on what he meant to the team.

He spent years becoming the face of the Tigers’ pitching staff and helped end Detroit’s long playoff drought. A return this soon after his departure may feel strange, but it also gives fans an opportunity to show their appreciation.

Hinch expects Skubal to receive a warm reception. Once the first pitch is thrown, though, that sentiment will have to disappear.

articles.standfirst: The Los Angeles Dodgers ended up winning, but Skubal could've put together an even better performance than he did.
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers ended up winning, but Skubal could've put together an even better performance than he did.
articles.body:
Friday night was always going to be a special one for Tarik Skubal . Making his first start in Detroit as a member of the Los Angeles Dodgers , emotions were at an all-time high for the Cy Young pitcher.

Ultimately, Skubal ended up pitching a fantastic game . He held the Detroit Tigers lineup to just four hits and one run across six innings, while striking out seven batters . His performance could have been bigger and better, but Dodgers manager Dave Roberts decided to pull Skubal from the game after just 83 pitches thrown .

Dave Roberts plays it safe with Tarik Skubal, even on his return to Detroit Tigers stadium

Following the decision, the broadcast camera picked up Roberts and Skubal discussing the decision in the dugout . The pitcher was obviously disappointed by the decision, but it wasn't a heated conversation . Still, it left Skubal dissatisfied; he wanted to go as long as possible on such a special night .

Skubal spoke a little bit about the situation after the game, explaining that Roberts told him he's going to be needed for the long haul . Obviously, the main thing on Roberts and the Dodgers' minds is winning another World Series . They need Skubal healthy in order for that to happen.

Roberts' move ended up paying off, at least. T he Dodgers' bullpen blanked the Tigers for the last three innings, and Freddie Freeman notched the game-winning hit in the 8th inning .

articles.title: Which National League team can actually beat the back-to-back champion Dodgers?
articles.standfirst: Los Angeles did not exactly make the challenge easier for everyone else
articles.summary: Los Angeles did not exactly make the challenge easier for everyone else
articles.body:
The National League has spent most of the 2026 season trying to answer the same question: Who can stop the Dodgers? The Los Angeles franchise enters the final stretch of the regular season as the defending World Series champion for the second consecutive year, having become one of only 14 teams in MLB history to win back-to-back titles.

And the Dodgers did not exactly make the challenge easier for everyone else. At the trade deadline, Los Angeles added reigning American League Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal to an already loaded roster, giving the champions another formidable weapon for October. But the National League does have legitimate challengers.

The Atlanta Braves, Milwaukee Brewers and Dodgers currently lead their divisions, while the Chicago Cubs and Philadelphia Phillies occupy wild-card positions and the San Diego Padres and Arizona Diamondbacks remain locked in a fight for the final postseason berth. So, which team has the best chance of ending Los Angeles' reign?

If there is one team that has earned the right to believe it can beat Los Angeles, it is Atlanta. The Braves just swept the Dodgers in a three-game series, winning the finale 1-0 behind a brilliant complete-game performance from Chris Sale . Sale struck out 11 and allowed only five hits without issuing a walk. That sweep was significant for another reason: Atlanta had not swept Los Angeles since 2013.

The Braves also clinched the season series against the Dodgers, adding another layer of confidence to a potential October matchup. Atlanta currently sits near the top of the NL standings and has been playing outstanding baseball late in the season. The Braves entered Sunday riding a seven-game winning streak. More importantly, they have the kind of roster that can win a playoff series in multiple ways.

If Atlanta is the obvious challenger, Milwaukee might be the most dangerous team nobody wants to face. The Brewers currently own the best record in the National League, sitting at 85-52 entering Sunday's action. They also boast a remarkable +177 run differential. That is not the profile of a team simply benefiting from a favorable schedule.

Milwaukee has consistently played winning baseball throughout the season and has enough pitching, defense and offensive balance to create problems in a short playoff series. The Brewers also have something every Dodgers challenger needs: confidence. They are not intimidated by Los Angeles, and their consistency gives them a legitimate path to earning home-field advantage deep into October.

Philadelphia presents a different type of challenge. The Phillies are currently holding a wild-card position and have been one of the hottest teams in baseball recently, entering Sunday with an 8-2 record over their previous 10 games. Their biggest advantage is experience.

Philadelphia has been built to contend in October, with a veteran-heavy roster accustomed to the intensity of postseason baseball. When a series becomes a battle of stars and big moments, that experience can become extremely valuable. The Phillies may not have the same regular-season dominance as Milwaukee, but nobody should be eager to face them in a five- or seven-game series.

The Cubs might be the most explosive team in the wild-card picture. Chicago has scored 720 runs this season, ranking among the National League's most productive offenses, and Pete Crow-Armstrong has emerged as a major power threat with 36 home runs entering Sunday's action. He just blasted three homers and drove in six runs during a 17-5 demolition of Cincinnati.

That type of offensive firepower can make a playoff series unpredictable.

The Cubs would need their pitching to hold up against Los Angeles, but if their lineup gets hot at the right time, they could turn any series into a slugfest.

The Padres remain in the fight for the final National League wild-card position, battling the Diamondbacks. That alone makes them difficult to dismiss. San Diego has enough talent to cause problems if it gets into the postseason, although injuries have become a concern. The Padres placed Gavin Sheets and Luis Rengifo on the injured list Sunday while remaining tied with Arizona for the crucial playoff berth.

Their biggest challenge is simply getting there. If San Diego survives the wild-card race, however, it would enter October with nothing to lose, and plenty of talent capable of changing a series. Less likely than Atlanta or Milwaukee, but potentially dangerous if it gets healthy at the right time.

The Atlanta Braves, Milwaukee Brewers and Dodgers currently lead their divisions, while the Chicago Cubs and Philadelphia Phillies occupy wild-card positions and the San Diego Padres and Arizona Diamondbacks remain locked in a fight for the final postseason berth. So, which team has the best chance of ending Los Angeles' reign?

If there is one team that has earned the right to believe it can beat Los Angeles, it is Atlanta. The Braves just swept the Dodgers in a three-game series, winning the finale 1-0 behind a brilliant complete-game performance from Chris Sale . Sale struck out 11 and allowed only five hits without issuing a walk. That sweep was significant for another reason: Atlanta had not swept Los Angeles since 2013.

The Braves also clinched the season series against the Dodgers, adding another layer of confidence to a potential October matchup. Atlanta currently sits near the top of the NL standings and has been playing outstanding baseball late in the season. The Braves entered Sunday riding a seven-game winning streak. More importantly, they have the kind of roster that can win a playoff series in multiple ways.

If Atlanta is the obvious challenger, Milwaukee might be the most dangerous team nobody wants to face. The Brewers currently own the best record in the National League, sitting at 85-52 entering Sunday's action. They also boast a remarkable +177 run differential. That is not the profile of a team simply benefiting from a favorable schedule.

Milwaukee has consistently played winning baseball throughout the season and has enough pitching, defense and offensive balance to create problems in a short playoff series. The Brewers also have something every Dodgers challenger needs: confidence. They are not intimidated by Los Angeles, and their consistency gives them a legitimate path to earning home-field advantage deep into October.

Philadelphia presents a different type of challenge. The Phillies are currently holding a wild-card position and have been one of the hottest teams in baseball recently, entering Sunday with an 8-2 record over their previous 10 games. Their biggest advantage is experience.

Philadelphia has been built to contend in October, with a veteran-heavy roster accustomed to the intensity of postseason baseball. When a series becomes a battle of stars and big moments, that experience can become extremely valuable. The Phillies may not have the same regular-season dominance as Milwaukee, but nobody should be eager to face them in a five- or seven-game series.

The Cubs might be the most explosive team in the wild-card picture. Chicago has scored 720 runs this season, ranking among the National League's most productive offenses, and Pete Crow-Armstrong has emerged as a major power threat with 36 home runs entering Sunday's action. He just blasted three homers and drove in six runs during a 17-5 demolition of Cincinnati.
That type of offensive firepower can make a playoff series unpredictable.
The Cubs would need their pitching to hold up against Los Angeles, but if their lineup gets hot at the right time, they could turn any series into a slugfest.

The Padres remain in the fight for the final National League wild-card position, battling the Diamondbacks. That alone makes them difficult to dismiss. San Diego has enough talent to cause problems if it gets into the postseason, although injuries have become a concern. The Padres placed Gavin Sheets and Luis Rengifo on the injured list Sunday while remaining tied with Arizona for the crucial playoff berth.

Their biggest challenge is simply getting there. If San Diego survives the wild-card race, however, it would enter October with nothing to lose, and plenty of talent capable of changing a series. Less likely than Atlanta or Milwaukee, but potentially dangerous if it gets healthy at the right time.

articles.body:
The snapshot of this series opener in Los Angeles sums up two seasons heading in opposite directions. The Dodgers come into the matchup perched atop the National League West, with a record of 82 wins and 55 losses.

That record places them fourth in the Major League global landscape and gives them a run differential of +153 (670 scored to only 517 allowed), one of the strongest balances in baseball. They lead their division comfortably over Arizona and San Diego, and their offense of more than 670 runs is among the most productive in the league.

On the other side of the diamond, the St. Louis Cardinals are going through an uphill stretch. With a record of 68 wins and 70 losses, they sit in third place in the National League Central Division, behind Milwaukee and the Chicago Cubs, and with a negative run differential of -15 (610 scored, 625 allowed).

It is a team below .500 that needs long streaks if it wants to dream of a Wild Card berth, and visiting Chavez Ravine is hardly the ideal setting to get back on track.

What time does each game in the Dodgers vs Cardinals series start?

The first game is scheduled for this Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 7:10 p.m. Eastern Time (6:10 p.m. Central Time and 4:10 Pacific Time). The venue is Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, a colossus with a capacity of 56,000 fans that is one of the most intimidating fortresses in baseball.

This is the opener of the series between the two teams; the remaining games will have the following start times:

Dodgers vs Cardinals Game 2

Date : Wednesday, September 2

Dodgers vs Cardinals Game 3

Date : Thursday, September 3

Where can you watch the Dodgers vs Cardinals game live?

For audiences across the country, the matchup between Los Angeles and Saint Louis can be streamed on MLB.tv and on ESPN. Locally, it can be watched on SportsNet LA for Los Angeles.

What will the lineups be for Dodgers vs Cardinals?

Both teams arrive with their 26-player rosters available. The Dodgers present a luxury rotation led by Japanese pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto and left-handers Blake Snell and Tyler Glasnow, with the young Roki Sasaki providing a high-voltage alternative.

The Angels bullpen is one of their greatest weapons: Puerto Rican Edwin Díaz and veterans Blake Treinen, Evan Phillips, and Tanner Scott provide depth to close out tight innings.

For Saint Louis, the responsibility of slowing the home team's offense will fall to a younger pitching staff, with names like Dustin May, Matthew Liberatore, and Andre Pallante leading the rotation.

In the batting order, Panamanian Iván Herrera stands out as the designated hitter, along with Venezuelan catcher Pedro Pagés. Mexican Luis Gastélum appears among the Cardinals relievers.

Dodgers vs Cardinals: Betting markets and favorite to win the series

The sportsbook has not yet published the moneyline or the official total for this matchup, as the date falls outside the current betting range. Even so, the context clearly indicates which way the line will move when the market opens.

The Dodgers, playing at home, with the better record, a much superior run differential, and with Yamamoto or Snell as possible starters, will be clear favorites when the board opens. The Cardinals, a team below .500 and on the road, will come in as the underdog with plus odds (a payout greater than even money).

When the line appears, the value will probably be on the St. Louis side in the run line market (+1.5 runs), baseball’s usual reference point: even if the Dodgers win, one-run games are commonplace in the majors, and a heavily favored home team does not always cover the 1.5-run margin.

Betting on the Dodgers to win outright at short odds usually offers little value; the quality gap comes at a high price.
